Exact LF ranges cannot separate complete witnesses.

Pius VI Morbinio confraternity privilege confirmation DCCCXXX is identifiable at LF113255–113270, but title/protocol/body share literal LF with DCCCXXIX ending, and later clauses are displaced (LF113436–113450 continue LF113407–113430 out of order). Requires a separately replayable coordinate-based derivative.

DCCCXXXI is explicitly EDITTO LF113506, issued by Fabrizio Ruffo, papal/cameral treasurer, named LF113509–113513. It quotes Pius VI’s 12 February 1791 chirograph within §§2–6, then resumes Ruffo’s execution/penalty provisions at LF114045 and his Monte Citorio dating of 4 March 1791 LF114092–114094. Papal mandate/quotation does not make this an independently authored papal edict.

Distinct embedded Pius VI chirograph addressed to Fabrizio Ruffo begins LF113577–113582 and closes explicitly Dato dal Nostro palazzo apostolico Vaticano...12.febbraro1791 at LF114031–114033. It is identified separately within Ruffo’s non-papal edict. Its clauses contain displaced continuations: forni quadrelli... LF113630 belongs after LF113591 and altrettanto alle dette vene... LF113633 after LF113608. Raw-LF order therefore cannot support a complete reading witness.
